name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Income support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families.
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments, subject to scheme eligibility and exclusions.
documents: Landholding/farmer records as required by the State/UT
application_method: Online through the official PM-KISAN portal and through designated State/UT processes.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections to eligible adult women from poor households.
benefit: Deposit-free LPG connection, with the scheme providing applicable connection assistance and a free first refill and stove as specified by PMUY.
documents: Ration card or family composition document
application_method: Apply through an LPG distributor or the official online PMUY process.

source.name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
description: Housing assistance for eligible families living in urban areas.
benefit: Housing assistance through one of the PMAY-U 2.0 verticals, subject to the applicable eligibility and verification.
documents: Documents required by the applicable PMAY-U 2.0 vertical
application_method: Apply through the official PMAY-U 2.0 system and the relevant State/UT/ULB/implementing agency.

source.name: PMAY-U 2.0, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
description: Merit-based financial assistance for eligible students pursuing higher education.
benefit: Scholarship assistance of ₹12,000 per year for the first three years and ₹20,000 per year for the fourth and fifth years, according to the applicable course and scheme rules.
documents: Documents required through the National Scholarship Portal and institution verification process
application_method: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal.

source.name: National Scholarship Portal / Ministry of Education

name: Post Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
description: Scholarship support for students with benchmark disabilities pursuing post-matric education.
benefit: Scholarship support including maintenance allowance, disability allowance, reimbursement of eligible compulsory fees and book allowance, according to course and applicable rules.
application_method: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal.

source.name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities, Government of India
